categories.main_business_segments: Richinfo Technology Co., Ltd. primarily operates in three main business segments: collaborative office products, intelligent channel products, and intelligent computing services and data intelligence. The collaborative office segment includes AI-powered email systems, office assistants, and unified office platforms targeting large enterprises and government institutions. The intelligent channel segment focuses on digital marketing, customer acquisition, and operational platforms integrating AI and data analytics. The intelligent computing segment offers cloud lifecycle management, AI native cloud computing solutions, and data governance services for various industries.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company leverages advanced AI technologies including large model training and inference platforms, multi-modal AI, multi-agent collaboration, and AI native cloud computing architectures. It employs proprietary technologies such as Rich AIBox (an AI application development platform), Rich AICloud (AI native cloud computing solution), and Rich Mail (a secure, domestically certified email system). The firm integrates AI with 3D, AR/VR, digital twin, and big data technologies, and uses cloud-native, containerized deployment methods with heterogeneous GPU support for scalable AI computing.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers include large state-owned enterprises and government agencies in telecommunications (China Mobile, China Unicom), finance (China Bank, China Life Insurance), energy (State Grid, Southern Power Grid), transportation (China Southern Airlines, China Railway Signal & Communication), and public sectors. The company serves over 1 billion end users through telecom operator platforms and targets large and medium-sized enterprises, government bodies, and educational institutions for its collaborative office and AI solutions.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates primarily in China with major business concentrated in South China (Guangdong), East China, North China, Southwest China, Central China, Northwest China, and Northeast China regions. It also has subsidiaries and operations in Hong Kong and multiple Chinese provinces. The company maintains R&D centers in Shenzhen, Guangzhou, Beijing, and other cities, and serves customers nationwide.
categories.supply_chain_position: Richinfo Technology operates primarily in the midstream and downstream segments of the software and IT services supply chain. It develops proprietary software products, AI platforms, and cloud computing solutions, and provides technical services and system integration to enterprise customers. The company acts as a core technology and service provider to telecom operators and large enterprises, enabling digital transformation and AI application deployment.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company’s strategic focus is on AI-driven digital transformation, emphasizing the development of a full-stack AI service ecosystem from intelligent computing infrastructure to AI application platforms and vertical industry solutions. Key R&D initiatives include enhancing AI large model training and inference efficiency, multi-agent AI collaboration, AI native cloud computing, digital twin technology, and intelligent office automation. The firm invests heavily in AI algorithm platforms, intelligent marketing, digital human technologies, and cloud-native architectures to maintain technological leadership and expand AI application scenarios.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is generated mainly through direct sales of software products, customized software development services, technical support, cloud computing services, and system integration projects. The company also earns income from licensing its AI platforms and solutions, as well as from ongoing operational support and effect-based service contracts. It operates primarily on a direct sales model to large enterprise and government customers.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: Richinfo Technology is positioned as a leading domestic provider in the Chinese software and AI services market, especially in the trusted computing (信创) and AI native cloud computing sectors. It competes with other major Chinese IT service providers and AI technology firms, leveraging its patented technologies, extensive client base, and strong partnerships with telecom operators. The company holds a competitive edge in AI large model platforms, secure email systems, and integrated AI office solutions, supported by national certifications and industry awards.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company reported operating revenue of approximately RMB 1.65 billion, representing a 10.41% increase over the previous year. Net profit attributable to shareholders was RMB 230 million, a 29.11% decrease due to valuation impacts, while net profit excluding non-recurring items grew by 16.81%. The company’s total assets reached RMB 3.43 billion, with equity attributable to shareholders at RMB 2.75 billion. R&D investment increased by 16.92% to RMB 350 million, accounting for 21.2% of revenue, reflecting a strong growth trajectory focused on innovation.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Richinfo Technology emphasizes its proprietary AI large model technology ecosystem, secure and domestically certified email systems, and integrated AI office and marketing platforms as key differentiators. Its Rich AIBox platform offers flexible, customizable AI application development with multi-agent collaboration and advanced reasoning capabilities. The company’s AI native cloud computing solution provides scalable, cost-effective AI computing infrastructure with high stability and performance. Its focus on AI-driven digital transformation, deep industry integration, and comprehensive service offerings delivers unique value in efficiency, security, and intelligent automation to large enterprises and government clients.
